name: Media.com
verdict: MEDIA.COM GmbH, a Brilon telecommunications-engineering firm represented by its managing director Markus Frese. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Private German telecommunications-technique contractor (Brilon, HRB 7317 Arnsberg), represented by managing director Markus Frese; no state body or fund found anywhere in the chain, and no human-rights finding against the company. Not the same company as Mediacom Communications Corporation (US cable operator, Fiorentina's front sponsor), which is a separate record.
